'''Philosopher's stew''' (Dutch: ''filosoof'') is a dish from [[Cookbook:Cuisine of the Netherlands|the Netherlands]]. It is an oven-baked dish made of beef, potatoes, onions and apples. 

==Ingredients==

*300–400 [[Cookbook:Gram|grams]] cold, [[Cookbook:Stewing|stewed]] [[Cookbook:Beef|beef]]
*40 grams [[Cookbook:Fat|fat]] (cold [[Cookbook:Gravy|gravy]] or [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]])
*4 large [[Cookbook:Onion|onions]], [[Cookbook:Slicing|sliced]] into thin rings
*800 grams boiled [[Cookbook:Potato|potatoes]], cut into slices (about 4 mm)
*[[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]]
*Ground [[Cookbook:Black Pepper|black pepper]]
*[[Cookbook:Nutmeg|Nutmeg]]
*3½ dl (350 [[Cookbook:Milliliter|ml]]) skimmed gravy
*4 spoonfuls of crushed white [[Cookbook:Bread|bread]] (stale)
*[[Cookbook:Apple|Apple]] compôte

==Procedure==
# Cut the meat into small pieces (about 5 mm). 
# Heat the frying fat or butter in a [[Cookbook:Frying Pan|frying pan]] or a small [[Cookbook:Wok|wok]]. [[Cookbook:Frying|Fry]] the onions until the are golden brown. Put the onions aside.
# Put a layer after layer of potatoes, meat and onions on top of each other in an [[Cookbook:Baking Dish|oven-proof dish]]. Season each layer of potatoes with salt, pepper and nutmeg. Make sure the top layer consists of potatoes.
# Pour the gravy over the top layer and scatter the bread crumbs over it all.
# Put some lumps of butter here and there.
# Pre-heat the [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] to 200°C. [[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] the dish for about 30 minutes.
# Serve immediately with the apple compôte

==Notes, tips, and variations==
* The taste improves if you let the dish rest for a while in the fridge before putting it in the oven.
